utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that if I can keep track of the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Noah — I can help keep the schedule straight if you want.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I heard the carpool might shift to a slightly earlier pickup this week. I’m still checking the details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I just need to know the exact time so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check with the driver and text you the exact time as soon as I know. Should have an answer for you soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Opal — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time and day are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — I’m checking whether it’s for Tuesday or Thursday and which pickup spot works best.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No rush—just let me know which day you pick and I’ll plan around it. I can do either pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I can share the carpool invite with everyone on the block if you want. Just tell me the details and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate that — just send it around as a simple carpool invite.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send out a simple carpool invite to the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing, Leo — I can help coordinate the carpool. What days and times do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I need Mondays and Wednesdays around 8:00 AM, and Fridays at about 3:30 PM.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll map those out and see who’s available for Mondays and Wednesdays at 8:00 AM, plus Fridays at 3:30 PM. I’ll let you know once I’ve got the carpool covered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and who’s riding with us? I want to make sure I have the details right before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep — I’m pretty sure the pickup is at 7:30, and it’s me, you, and Mia riding together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — so it’s 7:30 with you, me, and Mia, right? I’ll confirm once I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can do carpool pickup this week, but I need the school release times first so I can plan around work.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’ll grab the school release times and send them over so you can plan. Appreciate you taking pickup this week.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — once you send the release times, I’ll lock in my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the carpool might be changing soon—do you know what time they’re planning now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not totally sure yet, but I can check and let you know as soon as I hear the new time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules—that’d be great. I’m just trying to make sure I don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time are we doing the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time again? I just want to make sure we’re on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — what time were we saying again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m in. Just let me know the pickup time and where you want me to be.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I’ll check the pickup time and text you the spot as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—just text me when you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye on supplies and make sure we’re set for the ride.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll make sure everyone hears the carpool plan and knows the timing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Rey — I heard the carpool’s still on, right? I can help figure out the timing if you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Ira, yeah, it’s still on. I’d appreciate help with the timing if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I can check a couple options and see what works best for everyone. Want me to start with morning pickup or the return trip?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the carpool. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—I'll circle back with the carpool details and make sure we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—carpool. I might’ve missed a change; what’s the plan now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still meeting at 7:30 by the corner. If that changed, I’ll text you right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 7:30 by the corner works for me. Thanks—text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli—I've got my car available if you need another ride for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple—what time are we leaving, and where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s leave at 7:30, and you can meet me out front by my driveway.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! I’m thinking weekdays around 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM — does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that should work for me on weekdays. Just let me know which days you need, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help keep the carpool plans in sync. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I was thinking around 7:30 AM. That should give us enough time to get everyone where they need to be.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 7:30 AM works for me — I’ll help keep everyone posted so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help organize the carpool. What days and times should I plan for, and who’s riding?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — let’s plan for weekdays at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., with three riders total.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll set that up for weekdays at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. for the three riders.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, has the carpool time changed? I’m usually the last to hear these things, so I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t heard any change yet, but I’ll check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what time do you need me for carpool?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I need you at 7:30 in the morning, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7:30 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time and pickup order were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the time and who you’d pick up first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do 8:15, and I’d pick up Maya first, then Leo on the way.
